notes.title: Early Access Update Notes #1
notes.notes:
Hello Scrapworks Simulator players! Here are the improvements we've made in our latest update:

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Lighting improvements have been made.
[/list]


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]The issue causing the money to mistakenly be $10,000 due to a bug has been fixed.
[/list]


[b]Upcoming Updates[/b]
[list]
[*]A keybinding customization option will be added.
[/list]

[b]Updates during the Early Access period will be determined based on player feedback and released in batches. In addition to these updates, various bug fixes will also be implemented.[/b]


Don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist to be notified when it launches! 🎮✨

💬 You can also support us by sharing your experience in a review for Scrapworks Simulator! 🙌

See you in the game! 🎮

notes.title: Demo Update Notes #1
notes.notes:
Hello Scrapworks Simulator Demo players! Here are the new additions and improvements we've made with our latest update:

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list] [*]The positions of the boxes have been adjusted so that when carrying multiple boxes by hand, they no longer obstruct the player's camera view. 
[*]The prices of the Foundry, Warehouse, and Car Workshop buildings have been reduced. [/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b] 
[list] [*]A bug that caused the game not to save after bringing scrap found in the tutorial stage to the shop has been fixed. [/list]

If you encountered any of these bugs, we appreciate your patience and understanding.

notes.title: Scrapworks Simulator Demo Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[b]Scrapworks Simulator Demo Coming Soon![/b]

Hello everyone,  
We have an exciting announcement for Scrapworks Simulator! A tutorial-focused demo that lets you explore the core mechanics of our game will be available very soon! 🎮  

In this demo, you will:  

[list]  
[*] Learn the core dynamics of the game.  
[*] Explore how to collect parts and turn them into valuable products.
[*] Search for scrap parts in abandoned areas.  
[*] Build workshop buildings.  
[*] Sell the scrap parts you find in your shop.  
[*] Combine the parts you find and sell them for a higher price in your shop.  
[*] Create molds for scrap parts and produce them yourself in your workshop.  
[/list]  

Follow Scrapworks Simulator on Steam and add it to your wishlist to be instantly notified about the demo release and upcoming updates!

🔔 Add to wishlist: [[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3318580/Scrapworks_Simulator/]Steam Page[/url]]
